name: Layout sweep LH-196: tables and charts
description: Keynote 0.36.0 round, changelog matrix rows of the layout sweep (opf#1425). Each slide is built to show the weakness 0.35.1 had and the fix of 0.36.0. Fictional data.

slides.title: M15 A11: table beside a column chart grows, top-aligned
slides.notes: M15 / A11 (LH-196). Look at: no layout: the short table beside the column chart is larger than 0.35.1 and its top is on the chart box top line (where the chart heading stands).

slides.title: M15 A11: table beside a line chart grows, top-aligned
slides.notes: M15 / A11 (LH-196). Look at: as above, beside a line chart.

slides.title: M15 A11: table beside a pie grows, centered
slides.notes: M15 / A11 (LH-196). Look at: beside a pie the grown table stays centered on the pie (no top line).

slides.title: M18 C10: two comparison tables grow together
slides.notes: M18 / C10 (LH-196). Look at: comparison: both tables larger than 0.35.1 (header ~25 px -> larger), same size, same top line.

slides.title: M19 C12: dashboard table grows under its metrics
slides.notes: M19 / C12 (LH-196). Look at: dashboard: the two-row table under the three metrics is larger and follows the metrics one gap down (one centered group); metrics keep their size.

slides.title: M25 COL-2: table in a column grows beside short text
slides.notes: M25 / COL-2 (LH-196). Look at: two-column: the table (left) is larger than its 25 px role size; the text is not smaller.

slides.title: M25 COL-2: wide table takes the width it needs
slides.notes: M25 / COL-2 (LH-196). Look at: three-column: the four-column table gets the widest column (up to 65% of the row) at >= 25 px; 0.35.1: one third, table at the 16 px floor.

slides.title: M26 LH-03: small column chart axis ends at tallest bar
slides.notes: M26 / LH-03 (LH-196). Look at: lone two-column chart with labeled columns and hidden value axis: the North column reaches the top of the plot under its label (c:max = 42 in the export); 0.35.1: round end up to 25% above.

slides.title: M37 A12: pie and its value list stand together
slides.notes: M37 / A12/C11 (LH-196). Look at: lone pie: the value list stands next to the pie (< 60 px gap) and the pie+list group is centered; 0.35.1: list pinned to the far right ~270 px away.

slides.title: M37 C11: doughnut and its value list together
slides.notes: M37 / A12/C11 (LH-196). Look at: as above for a doughnut.

slides.title: M39 TAB-1: three-row table and note grow

blocks.text: Test with two teams for six weeks. Measure task completion and time before deciding what to scale.

slides.notes: M39 / TAB-1 (LH-196). Look at: table layout: a three-row table and its note grow (cells and note larger than 25 px role size); 0.35.1 left a third of the body empty.

slides.title: M40 TAB-2: table-beside table grows with a note

blocks.text: Test with two teams for six weeks. Measure task completion and time before deciding what to scale.

slides.notes: M40 / TAB-2 (LH-196). Look at: table-beside: the table grows past its 25 px role size and starts on the same line as its note.

slides.title: M40 TAB-2: table-beside table grows beside a metric
slides.notes: M40 / TAB-2 (LH-196). Look at: table-beside with a metric aside: table grows, metric keeps its size, both start on one line.
